chunk.content: In Australia the fourfinger threadfin (Eleutheronema tetradactylum) goes by local names that call it a salmon, such as blue salmon, Cooktown salmon and Rockhampton salmon.
chunk.source_quote: Local Names: AUSTRALIA: Blue threadfin, Blue salmon, Cooktown salmon, Rockhampton salmon, Giant threadfin,

source.title: Threadfins of the World (Family Polynemidae), FAO Species Catalogue for Fishery Purposes No. 3 (Motomura 2004): Eleutheronema
